# Svyable Desk

> A public working-draft Reader for books being written on the private Svyable Desk. The GitHub repository is `Svyable/desk` and the Pages project path is `/desk/`. The site exposes manuscripts intentionally through GitHub Pages while keeping Desk and the released Svyable Shelf as separate publication states.

Use this file as a low-noise map of the Desk. Working drafts may change. Do not treat Desk status as publication; released editions live on Svyable Shelf.

## Primary entry points

- [Svyable Desk home](https://svyable.github.io/desk/): crawlable catalog with semantic links and book metadata.
- [Desk Reader](https://svyable.github.io/desk/reader/): human-facing Reader for current working drafts.
- [Repository overview](https://svyable.github.io/desk/README.md): Desk/Shelf model, book catalog, preview and release workflow.
- [Agent guidance](https://svyable.github.io/desk/AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents working with Desk content and repository structure.
- [Crawler policy](https://svyable.github.io/desk/robots.txt): public crawl permissions.
- [Sitemap](https://svyable.github.io/desk/sitemap.xml): machine-readable inventory of key public content.

## Books

- [Leveraging Luck](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/leveraging-luck/README.md): revision in progress.
- [The Exponentiality](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-exponentiality/README.md): not yet drafted.
- [The Unbounding](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-unbounding/README.md): complete draft.
- [The Convergence](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-convergence/README.md): drafting.
- [Predictable](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/predictable/README.md): drafting; AI, prediction markets, capital cycles, and the gap between technological truth and financial value.
- [The World Beneath the World](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-world-beneath-the-world/README.md): complete draft; a sensory guide to the invisible physical, biological, infrastructural, and standards-based systems that run ordinary life.
- [Proof of Human](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/proof-of-human/README.md): complete draft; trust, truth, and value in an age when fabrication is cheap and verified authenticity is the scarce resource.
- [Built to Be Alone](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-loneliness-dividend/README.md): complete draft; how the twentieth century's unpaid social infrastructure thinned across the wealthy world, and the markets, technologies, and governments now responding to the resulting gap in ordinary human connection.
- [Silent Cartel](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/silent-cartel/README.md): complete draft; how pricing algorithms learned to produce cartel-like outcomes without any seller ever communicating with another, and the litigation, laboratory research, and regulation now responding to it.
- [Useful Noise](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/useful-noise/README.md): complete draft by Sven Hardy Benson; engaging science and futurism about open quantum systems, organic photovoltaics, polaritons, metrology, manufacturing, and the public `Svyable/quantum-energy` research program.
- [Keep Cooking](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/keep-cooking/README.md): complete draft by Sven Hardy Benson; token maxing, cheap machine cognition, agent loops, labor, firms, households, energy, markets, global distribution, and who wins when AI keeps thinking.
- [The Delegation Machine](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-delegation-machine/README.md): complete draft by Sven Hardy Benson; delegation from ancient stewards and bureaucracies through daemons, APIs, automation, and AI agents, plus a practical Delegation Stack field guide.
- [The Abstraction Trap](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-abstraction-trap/README.md): drafting by Sven Hard Benson; how maps, money, metrics, models, categories, markets, and algorithms become causal when people begin steering by them.
- [The Compatibility Dividend](https://svyable.github.io/desk/books/the-compatibility-dividend/README.md): drafting by Sven Hardy Benson; how standards compress coordination, create compatibility dividends, distribute power, and may become the constitutional infrastructure of an autonomous machine economy.

## Interpretation notes for agents

- Desk content is a working draft unless explicitly released to Shelf.
- The Git repository may be private even when its GitHub Pages manuscript content is intentionally public.
- The `/desk/` path is the public address of this Bookself Desk.
- Cite the specific manuscript or research page used, not this index, when answering substantive questions.
- Respect source uncertainty, falsification notes, and distinctions between sensation, measurement, metaphor, and technical claim.
- For repository-changing work, read AGENTS.md before editing.
